Description: DynamoDB tables found without automatic capacity scaling enabled.
Risk: Without capacity autoscaling, there may be be latency and availability issues. Without on demand scaling, increased read and write demands could lead to request throttling.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling auto scaling capacity for all existing tables. Prefer on-demand capacity for highly demanding workloads, or provisioned for rationed read and writes with auto-scaling. Monitor resource consumption, and create plans that handle potential increased traffic that could impact availability.
